content: Root cause: The bug was caused by improper handling of the `underrun` variable in the `op_jack_cb` function. Specifically, the `underrun` variable was being reset to 0 after the check for an underrun condition, which could lead to incorrect synchronization of audio channels when an underrun occurred. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the `underrun` variable is only reset to 0 after the necessary checks and adjustments for channel synchronization are completed.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by improper handling of the `underrun` variable in the `op_jack_cb` function. Specifically, the `underrun` variable was being reset to 0 after the check for an underrun condition, which could lead to incorrect synchronization of audio channels when an underrun occurred. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the `underrun` variable is only reset to 0 after the necessary checks and adjustments for channel synchronization are completed.
Patch:
From f5cf540d93fad86e1e3f761bd065be28b614f38b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Gregory Petrosyan <gregory.petrosyan@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Apr 2014 14:24:08 +0400
Subject: [PATCH] jack: fix underrun handling issue introduced in ed5234bbc

---
 jack.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/jack.c b/jack.c
index 2c55184..f30c328 100644
--- a/jack.c
+++ b/jack.c
@@ -131,6 +131,7 @@ static int op_jack_cb(jack_nframes_t frames, void* arg)
 
 	if (underrun) {
 		/* if there is an underrun channels may be out of sync. */
+		underrun = 0;
 		for (int i = 0; i < CHANNELS; i++) {
 			int pos_diff = buffer_pos_max - buffer_pos[i];
 			if (pos_diff <= 0) {
@@ -148,7 +149,6 @@ static int op_jack_cb(jack_nframes_t frames, void* arg)
 				underrun = 1;
 			}
 		}
-		underrun = 0;
 	}
 
 	if (paused) {
